verdict.rationale: Slack has no documented first-class bulk-operation feature. Its Web API (200+ methods) and MCP server could let an AI or script loop over many messages, lists, users or canvases. Workspace export and import tools offer bulk data movement, though community reports say exporting DMs and private channels needs Slack's approval. Missing for 10: documented batch or bulk endpoints, bulk edit or delete of messages, list items or channels, bulk actions through the MCP server or Slackbot, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows at scale.
